what: how each exported copy differs from its source. A replaced local path, folder name or account name, and a value whose descriptive wording was replaced, carries the hash of the original string. A dev-split projection is recorded by its rule, pattern and the number of items it removed, not by the items. The recount of expected.json names the tables it replaced.
